name: settings-page

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the most cards at once: profile fields, notification switches, appearance, security and danger.

tagline: A grid of bordered settings cards for profile, alerts, theme and security.
summary: An account settings screen laid out as a bordered three-column grid: profile fields with an avatar, notification switches, appearance and language options, security actions and a danger zone, with Cancel and Save at the bottom.
appearance: A near-black page fills with a fine grid of dark cards separated by single-pixel borders. Each card has a bold heading and grey helper line, then rows of labels, inputs, switches or outline buttons; the footer row holds a note beside Cancel and Save buttons.
behaviour: The page scrolls vertically through profile, notification, appearance, security and danger sections. Rows respond to input: text fields edit in place, switches flip, the theme control picks one of three, and the danger zone ends in a red Delete button.
demo_content: Account settings for Maya Chen at relay.app, with notification, appearance, security and danger sections.
use_when: A product needs one scannable account screen covering profile, notifications, appearance and security.
avoid_when: It hardcodes its own section content and sample user, so each card must be edited or replaced to match real fields.
customise: SettingsPage takes no props: section titles, field labels and the sample user are written inside, so you edit the file or compose the exported sections with your own fields.
weight_why: Plain form markup with no animation loop; the cost is the many imported controls.

a11y.note: Fields are properly labelled and reachable by keyboard; the theme control and switches rely on the imported parts for rings.

issues: The page heading is clipped at the top edge in every frame ('...unt settings').
polish_why: Coherent grid and consistent rows; the clipped heading and generic sample data hold it back.
title: Settings Page
